**Upcoming data releases that could shift odds include the next 00Z and 12Z model cycles plus any updated China Meteorological Administration bulletins,** which may refine cloud cover, precipitation timing, or subtle wind shifts affecting the peak reading. Traders are pricing the narrow uncertainty band around the consensus forecast while discounting low-probability outliers (≥35°C or ≤31°C) given the stable large-scale pattern.
